reddit.title: Introducing a New Materials System in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made a significant update to how you manage resources in Provincia! Instead of the previous cost badges that often obscured important information, each build tile now displays a detailed Materials sheet. This allows you to see exactly what resources you have stored versus what is required for your construction projects. Shortages are clearly highlighted, ensuring you know what you need before placing a building. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: New Materials Management Feature
steam.body: We're excited to announce a new feature in Provincia that enhances your building experience! The previous cost badges have been replaced with a detailed Materials system. Each build tile now shows exactly what materials you have stored and what you need for construction, with shortages clearly indicated. This change allows for better planning and resource management as you expand your colony. Read more about this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
